title: Fixed finite coordinates for completed-ring open exchange
statement: For the adic datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], open square and completed strict extensions [def-cbc-completed-strict-open-exchange], for $n\in\mathbf N$ put $B_n=A/I^{n+1}$ and let $r_{T,n}$ restrict finite constant-ring module sheaves to $A_T$ through the actual finite projection followed by the inverse constant-section coefficient comparison. These are the finite coordinates of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. For any morphism $f:S\to T$, fix the direct-image comparison $r_{T,n}\circ f_{n*}\simeq f_*\circ r_{S,n}$ by identity on every underlying section, where completed module pullback and its right adjoint are those of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Define the finite pullback comparison as its adjoint mate. For an open immersion $e:W\hookrightarrow T$ define the finite open-restriction comparison by sending each inverse-image unit generator to restriction along its adjoint localized-site arrow, and define the open-extension comparison as its mate. Use the finite constant-coefficient pullback of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact]. Compose these specified comparisons to identify the source and target ordinary open-exchange composites with their finite constant-coefficient composites followed by $r_{X',n}$. Define the finite-level coordinate change for a reduction tower by identity on sections, and combine it with those source and target comparisons. Finite reduction itself is derived scalar extension through the actual completed projection followed by restriction through the constant-section ring isomorphism. All comparisons are natural and completed-ring linear, with no completeness or quasi-compactness assumption. On cochain representatives, also define the reduction model map by the actual universal reduction counit; define the source and target model maps by composing that map with the exact open-extension factors and the actual universal completed-tower pullback counits, in their indicated source and target orders.
